latest.title: Is Your AWS Environment Really Secure? 5 Hands-On Tests
latest.description: Don’t just configure security. Prove it works.

latest.title: DevSecOps in Practice: Bringing Security Into Every Stage of CI/CD
latest.description: Learn how to integrate dependency scanning, secret detection, and container image checks into a CI/CD pipeline. This article covers practical ways to prioritize findings and set deployment rules without slowing down development.

latest.title: The Invisible Cloud: Building Self-Healing Systems with AWS
latest.description: Explore how AWS enables self-healing cloud infrastructure through automated monitoring, intelligent recovery, and scalable architecture. Discover how services like Amazon CloudWatch, EC2 Auto Scaling, and Elastic Load Balancing help build resilient applications that recover from failures with minimal manual intervention. A look into the future of reliable cloud engineering and DevOps automation.

latest.title: 🚀 Your Web App. Now on Lambda. ☁️
latest.description: Deploy your Node.js app with less setup. AWS Lambda Web Functions brings concurrent requests, active CPU billing, and multi-region deployment to your familiar web frameworks. Here’s what’s new and why it matters. ⚡

latest.title: Building a Cloud Cost Optimization Engine on AWS: A Beginner's Guide
latest.description: Learn how to identify unnecessary cloud spending, monitor AWS resource usage, and optimize cloud costs using practical strategies. This article explores the key concepts, tools, and best practices that students and developers can use to build more cost-efficient cloud infrastructure.

latest.title: What If Your Application Could Scale Without You Managing a Single Server?
latest.description: What if your application could scale with demand without you managing the underlying servers? Explore how serverless computing works, how AWS Lambda enables event-driven applications, its cost benefits, real-world use cases, and the trade-offs developers should understand.

latest.title: GitOps with Argo CD: Automating Kubernetes Deployments
latest.description: Discover how GitOps simplifies Kubernetes application deployments by using Git as the single source of truth. Learn how Argo CD continuously monitors repositories, synchronizes Kubernetes resources, detects configuration drift, and enables reliable automated deployments.

What Happens When Your Cloud Application Fails at 3 AM? Designing Systems That Recover Automatically
latest.description: Exploring how AWS services can help developers build applications that detect failures, recover gracefully, and remain reliable.

latest.title: 🚀 Exploring Agentic AI on AWS
latest.description: Learned how Agentic AI goes beyond traditional chatbots by planning tasks, using tools, and executing multi-step workflows with AWS services like Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda.

trending.title: Let's Strands Decider our Role-Playing Game
trending.description:
If you build agents that call tools, you can let them act when they're sure and ask when they're not.
That is the job Strands Decider does. It is a small decision model that answers a typed question (yes/no, pick one, or a score) in a few hundred milliseconds on a laptop.

trending.title: How we ran the Kiro University Challenge as a community build-along: 141 builders at AWS User Group Madurai
trending.description: A community case study and playbook from AWS User Group Madurai. We - Vivek, Logesh and Poobalan turned Kiro's seven-lesson University Challenge into a build-along with four evening Circle sessions, a one-command setup that created a compliant repo and progress tracking, a leaderboard ranked by active days, and community rewards earned by rank. 141 members joined, 77 linked a repo, 38 demonstrated all seven lessons. Includes the numbers, what went wrong, and how to run it without a custom platform.

trending.title: Three Lessons from Kiro Nights Nairobi - Build, Break and Deploy with Kiro
trending.description: What creating a culture of innovation through the AWS AI/ML User Group Kenya taught us after organizing Kiro Nights Nairobi to Build, Break and Deploy with Kiro. Three lessons from a 2-hour buildathon using Kiro and deployment on AWS.

trending.title: Enterprise-Grade AI Agent Architecture Analysis on AWS: The Synergy of Amazon Bedrock and MCP
trending.description:
After attending AWS Cloud Day in Vietnam, I want to record the valuable insights I gained at the event.

The evolution of Generative AI is rapidly shifting from standalone Large Language Models (LLMs) to autonomous AI Agents capable of reasoning, acting, and interacting directly with enterprise data. This architecture outlines a comprehensive and robust solution on the AWS platform, maximizing the Amazon Bedrock ecosystem in conjunction with the MCP (Model Context Protocol) communication standard.

trending.title: AWS Community Day Adria - A conference that changes lives and careers
trending.description: AWS Community Day Adria is the biggest AWS-related event in the Adriatic / Balkans region and the biggest AWS Community Day in Europe. Organized by the community, for the community.

trending.title: Lambda Web Functions - Because Your Express App Deserves Better Than a Lambda Adapter
trending.description: Lambda Web Functions lets you deploy your port-listening Node.js web apps to Lambda with zero code changes. Multi-concurrent execution, active CPU billing, and global deployment in one command. The adapter era is over.

trending.title: OpenTelemetry: How to Eliminate Vendor Lock-in and Master Modern Observability
trending.description: Every engineering team eventually encounters the same observability dilemma: you adopt an all-in-one monitoring tool to gain visibility into your microservices. A few years later, pricing spikes, a better competitor emerges, or your architecture evolves beyond what that platform handles well.

trending.title: Benchmarking Strands Decider, LLM Classifiers and Bedrock Routing for Model Routing
trending.description: I routed 216 graded requests across Amazon Nova and Claude models with Strands Decider, five LLM classifiers, Bedrock Intelligent Prompt Routing and Bedrock Advanced Prompt Optimization. The decider judged request difficulty perfectly (ROC AUC 1.00 against 0.88 for Claude Sonnet 4.6) but cost about 0.0012 USD and 11 to 13 s per decision on a CPU microVM. Here are the numbers and the rules I now follow for when a decision model should judge and when a small LLM should route.

trending.title: AWS Lambda Response Streaming for Kotlin and Java
trending.description: Implementing HTTP response streaming behind API Gateway without writing a custom JVM runtime or adding Lambda layers.

trending.description: Learn AWS KMS encryption at rest with S3, IAM and key policies, Terraform examples, encryption enforcement, pricing, CloudTrail, and troubleshooting.
